trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: The bag is not enough big.
trap.right: The bag is not big enough.
trap.why: Em português “grande o suficiente” vem depois; o brasileiro, porém, pensa em “suficientemente grande” e coloca enough antes do adjetivo. Em inglês, depois.

mcq.q: This tea is **___** sweet to drink.
The result was so odd **___** we repeated it.

fix.right: It was such a big surprise.

rewrite.prompt: Use too: “The tea is very hot. I can’t drink it.”
rewrite.answer: The tea is too hot to drink.
